directive.quote: Main assigned Storage9 missing-contract paths; please own ONLY metadata for src/account/account_routes/recovery_source.rs, src/account/records_result.rs, src/server/records_result.rs and src/server.rs. No .rs changes.
directive.source: Authorized coordinator metadata assignment, not a new person message.

preserve: The native current key/grant/session identity belongs to the verified credential and account, rather than caller JSON or a display name.
A missing, expired or withdrawn credential cannot authorize delivery; effective scope and owner boundaries remain authoritative.
The original bearer is never returned or stored as recovery-source evidence.
allowed_deltas: NEW recovery-source projection reads the current native SignIn families without ordinary admission side effects: no last-use write, session sliding, token rotation or call counter. The cited retired owner supplied current credential lookup and sign-in naming, not this complete projection API.

NEW grant identity follows the stored grant through token refresh while changed scopes/reconsent/disconnect change or withdraw its evidence. Browser identity uses its stored session creation/method without renewing or recreating it.
NEW scope-set normalization affects only the transient private witness. Stored/public scope ordering stays untouched; storage custody and before/after marks reject mixed observations.
banned_substitutions: Invented byte-copy ancestry, a new result store, or a claim that metadata itself proves installed/customer behavior.

baseline.source_state: Metadata recorded after implementation. The pinned sources are behavioral evidence; no source-first copy or new test execution is claimed.

proof.qualification: Source-qualified metadata only. Existing committed controls are cited; this DATA-only lane launches no Cargo suite.
